answer: Behavior-fingerprint escrow stops fake identities. A newcomer locks 120 coins, 2x its 30-day earnings, and the network records its timing pattern as a fingerprint, audited on slots from a beacon. A tide of clones shares one fingerprint, so the audit seizes each deposit. Forging 1,000 identities costs 120,000 coins, far above flooding gains. An honest agent pays only 120 coins, unlocks after 10 epochs, and keeps undiluted rewards at its zenith.
